gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at the junction of Wai Yip Street and King Yip Street, running in a south-easterly direction for a distance of about 400 m. and terminating at its junction with Cha Kwo Ling Road, as shown coloured red on drawing No. KH 2079/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點為偉業街與敬業街會合點，向東南伸展約四百公尺，終點與茶果嶺道會合，其位置在 KH 2079/1 號圖則內用紅色標明。
